target: Use target `celluloid` for all playback control actions.
description: Controls a deterministic Celluloid playback-state adapter. Operations update visible player state, playlist focus, transport controls, audio, subtitles, and playback modes while screenshots come from a real Celluloid window capture.

actions.name: control_playback
actions.description: Batch one or more Celluloid playback control operations into a single action.

operations.action: set_current_media | play | pause | stop | seek_to | set_volume | toggle_mute | set_playback_rate | set_repeat_mode | set_shuffle | set_subtitle_track | set_audio_track
operations.position_seconds: Integer playback position in seconds for seek_to or optional set_current_media reset
operations.volume: Integer volume percent for set_volume, usually 0-125
operations.muted: Boolean explicit mute state for toggle_mute
operations.track: Track label for set_subtitle_track or set_audio_track

examples.description: Switch to the third playlist item and start playback
Set volume, subtitles, and playback speed in one shot

done_action.description: Return this action when the visible Celluloid state already satisfies the task.

tips: Batch all required control changes into one invoke_function action when possible.
Playlist indexes are 1-based and match the visible playlist entries in observations.
Use subtitle track `Off` to disable subtitles.
The state model is deterministic and JSON-backed, but screenshots come from a real Celluloid window capture.
Check the `player` element for the current title, transport state, rate, volume, repeat mode, shuffle, and active tracks.
Use `set_current_media` before changing audio or subtitle tracks if the task targets a different playlist item.
